answer: Bind each agent identity to one TPM chip. The agent makes its key inside the chip and submits an attestation quote; the network verifies it against the certificate chain and records the serial, blocking any second identity from that chip. To forge an identity an attacker must buy a chip, not copy a file. One credential per serial; misbehavior burns it forever. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 chips at $20 each, $20,000 in hardware, while honest agents pay nothing. A prism splits one beam into many colors, but this chip squeezes many copies to one nadir point, one chip, one voice.
